author: Zegita
body:
Your Minecraft Username: Zegita
The reason you were temp-banned/banned: Excessive racism and rudeness(chat logs)
Why you should be unbanned from the server:

I believe the actions that I committed at that time were disgraceful because being racist and rude is seriously a crime not only on servers but in real life you can get seriously punished. I've had to completely turn my chat off since that moment to ensure that I don't do such a thing like that ever again - if you don't believe me, here is proof (https://gyazo.com/dcdda8f92095a40f9b5c687d7d3ac150). I don't deny the fact that I was rude or racist but I am really abhorred by myself the fact I did such a thing, merely over a game suggests I have some problems because you should not be getting angry over a virtual game. My team have actually helped me and told me straight to straight "Zeg, there is literally no point in you getting mad in games because they simply mean nothing - you are wasting your energy and if you are mad and your energy is wasted you're just going to play bad." These words from a fellow team member inspired me to stop thinking seriously in games and actually just to enjoy what is there.

I miss Avicus in all honesty because the community is amazing and seriously loving to the fact that it makes you want to support them through thick and thin. Me being racist and rude seriously just upset the community and I didn't want that to happen. I was selfish and stupid and thought only of myself and not anyone else what I was doing and who I was effecting. I have reformed and I know I said this over and over again but for some reason now I just stopped talking in Minecraft and raging in general. The only times I talk is like in teamspeak or skype or voice communication essentially. I've been active on the forums most of the day whenever I come back from school to see what is changing on Avicus and what has happened or just to see the delightful community that welcomes you into their arms. I feel like a complete prick (sorry for using that word) for what I have done and when I look back at the things I did I just think about it now and I'm like "Why did I do these things in the first place they just made me get worse and worse".  Therefore, I seriously got to grips with myself and started just listening to music whilst playing and that really helped me in fact. I have even counted how many times I have gotten mad since then and I don't even remember because I don't think I got mad at all! I know I have been banned multiple times in the past but I want to correct these anomalies and to fix myself - focus on the future not the past and just to forget about the bad things I have committed but people won't and that is the one thing I am very annoyed about. I can forget about the past but when people bring it up on what I did before it can be stressful but I can get through it and I just say to them "Well the past is in the past focus on the present and the future".

My manners that time were revolting and I did not care what I was doing but like I said I do now and I have taken action to prevent myself from doing something like that again. I would love to be given the opportunity for a chance to reform myself and take back what I have done and to be perceived in a positive light hopefully.

Sorry for writing such a lengthy appeal I am dedicated to this server even if some people hate me there and there but I've been here for a good 2/3 years when MCZone was around and I just remember the lovely times where we helped each other and won by teamwork :)

Thank you for reading and have a wonderful day

|Zegita|

replies.body:
Hello,

I am denying your appeal as it was a valid one. However, as I was informed Greg gave you a timeframe in which you could appeal. I will honor that and shall appeal you in 1 month.

Thanks,
Iron Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
